props.description: Side-by-side dtype reveal: a DataFrame column 'H' fades in on both sides with identical values (28, 35, 42). Left panel shows dtype=object highlighted amber with label 'What Python read'. Right panel shows dtype=int64 in green with label 'What you assumed'. A typewriter animates the dtype tag on each side, then a red pulse throbs on the left — the mismatch made visceral before a word is spoken about the consequence.
